title: Inflation, corruption remain top concerns of Filipinos, survey says

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipinos remain most concerned about the need to control inflation, followed by fighting graft and corruption in government, according to Pulse Asia Research’s September 2026 Ulat ng Bayan survey. The survey was conducted from Sept. 17 to 24 through face-to-face interviews with 2,400 representative adults aged 18 and above. It has a margin of error of ±2 percentage points at the 95 percent confidence level.
